notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for RTI-owned joined-federate MOM removal counts. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAsetTiming, HLAinteger32BE, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies standard object registration, receive-order removal, direct and HLAsetTiming-periodic HLAobjectInstancesRemoved values, RTI ownership/reflection state, MIM-defined MOM service-report parameters, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics. The HLAfederate routing dimension is not treated as an HLAreportServiceInvocation parameter.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador MOM, object-management, declaration, ownership, service-report, and standard HLAsetTiming controls with FederateAmbassador removal, reflection, and RTI-ownership callbacks
